## Purpose
`LaunchWizard` is the single unified launch page for both deliverable families — prototypes ("web") and presentations ("deck") — replacing two formerly separate route pages. It hosts the `WizardStepper` (Template → Design System → Discovery, plus a Web/Deck mode toggle) and wraps it with the brief input, file/image/voice attachment, review-gate configuration, agent composer, save-workflow, and launch hand-off to the dashboard.

## Shape
- `LaunchWizard({ initialMode })` — the exported component; owns all wizard state (mode, template/design-system selection, brief, attached files/images, discovery answers, pipeline agents, review-gate selections) via `useState`/`useRef`.
- `MODE_CONFIG` / `STEPPER_MODE` / `modeFromStepper` — data-driven mode config (title, eyebrow, placeholder, save pipeline type) keyed on the generic `LaunchMode` ("prototype" | "ppt"), so mode differences are expressed as data rather than branching logic.
- `defaultAgentsFor(mode)` — derives the default agent lineup per mode from `LIBRARY_AGENTS`.
- `handleLaunch` — validates via `canContinue`/`hasBuildInput`, assembles the final brief (chain context + attached file blocks), builds a launch draft with `buildLaunchDraft`, writes it to `sessionStorage`, and routes to `/dashboard`.
- `handleSaveWorkflow` — persists the current wizard configuration via `createUserWorkflow` for later reuse.
- Effects handle: auth check + chain (upstream pipeline) pickup, one-shot draft restoration from `sessionStorage`, loading templates/design systems for both families up front, and mirroring speech-to-text into the brief.
- `onFilesPicked` — splits picked files into images (base64, sent out-of-band) vs. text/binary files (inlined into the brief via extracted text, truncated to `ATTACH_MAX_CHARS`).
- Local helper components `SectionLabel`, `Pill`, `StepNote` are small presentational pieces used only within this file.

## Why this shape
The file's own header comment states the rationale directly: the component is keyed on a generic `mode` value (never a per-workflow-name branch) so that every difference between the prototype and ppt flows is expressed as data in `MODE_CONFIG` or the `buildLaunchDraft` launch-contract library, keeping the wizard's dashboard hand-off byte-identical to the two retired pages it replaces.
